result.final_text:
## What this letter says
You came to the skin surgery clinic on 23 September 2026. The clinic removed the mole from your back. The wound was closed with 4 stitches. The lab result of the mole is not known yet. It usually takes 2 to 3 weeks.

## What you need to do
1. Have your stitches removed at your family doctor's surgery (GP surgery). Do this in 10 to 14 days.
2. Wait for the hospital to write to you. They will also write to your family doctor (GP) with the result of the mole test.

## Dates and medicines
- 23 September 2026: You had the mole removed at the skin surgery clinic.
- Stitches removal: in 10 to 14 days, at your GP surgery.
- Result of the mole test: usually 2 to 3 weeks. It is not known yet.
- Medicines: the letter does not list any medicines.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- When will I hear the result of my mole test?
- How do I book the stitches appointment at my GP surgery?
- Who do I contact if I have not heard about my result?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
